DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。園内について何かご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you have any questions about the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あの木を家族に「桜みたいな木」と話しましたが、本当に桜かは知りません。名前を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 桜みたいと話したが桜と未確認で正式名を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I told my family that tree was “a tree like a cherry tree,” but I don't know whether it really is one. I'd like to check its name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you said it looked like a cherry tree but have not confirmed that it is one, and ask its proper name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの木ですか。花が咲いている木でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which tree do you mean? Is it the one in bloom?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池のそばの小さい木です。花が桜に似ていると思っただけで、名札はまだ見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池そば小木で花が似ただけで札未確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The small tree beside the pond. I only thought its flowers looked like cherry blossoms; I haven't looked at its label yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it is the small tree by the pond, that only the flowers looked similar, and that you have not checked its label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 木の名札を確認しましょう。見た目が似ていても種類は違うことがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the tree's label. Trees can look alike but belong to different species.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。花の色だけで決めず、あの木に付いた名札を見ます。隣の木の札を読まないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色で決めず対象木の札を隣と混ぜず見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than deciding from the flower color alone, I'll look at the label attached to that tree. I want to avoid reading the neighboring tree's label by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the label on that particular tree rather than decide from its color or confuse it with the neighboring tree's label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この木の札には「ハナモモ」と書いてあります。今日は、この札が付いた木の名前としてお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: This tree's label says “flowering peach.” For today, please take that as the name of the tree bearing this label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家族には、私が桜に似ていると思ったことと、この木の名札にはハナモモと書いてあったことを分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 主観の類似と札の名称を家族へ区別して伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll explain separately to my family that I thought it looked like a cherry tree and that this tree's label said flowering peach.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will distinguish your impression of similarity from the name on the label when telling your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to look at the other trees too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。ただ、この木の名前を花の似た木全部に当てはめません。それぞれ札があるかを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 似た全木に名称を当てはめず各札を確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. But I won't apply this tree's name to every tree with similar flowers. I'll check whether each has its own label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not use that name for all similar trees and will check each tree's label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この木の札の名前はハナモモと確認できました。ほかの木は、それぞれの札をご覧ください。枝には触れず、引き続き園内をお楽しみください。ご質問ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed that this tree's label says flowering peach. For the other trees, please look at their respective labels. Please continue enjoying the park without touching the branches. Thank you for your question.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 次の列車は立って乗るかもしれないと聞きました。同行者が待合室で眠っているので、別の列車を選ぶ前に本人へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 眠る同行者へ確認してから立席可能性のある列車の変更を決めたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard we might have to stand on the next train. My companion is asleep in the waiting room, so I'd like to check with them before choosing another train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to consult your sleeping companion before deciding to change from the train on which you might have to stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同行者の方は、何時までに着く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: By what time does your companion need to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は急ぎませんが、本人の予定はまだ聞いていません。眠っているから時間に余裕があるとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人到着予定が未確認で睡眠から時間余裕と判断しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm not in a hurry, but I haven't asked about their schedule yet. I won't assume they have plenty of time just because they're sleeping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not checked their arrival schedule and will not infer that they have spare time from their being asleep.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、候補の時刻をメモできます。どこで待っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then you can write down the possible train times. Where are they waiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口側のベンチです。荷物をここへ置いて行かず、一緒に持って本人を起こして聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口ベンチへ荷物も持って起こしに行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: On the bench near the entrance. I'll take our luggage with me rather than leave it here, wake them up, and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take the luggage to the bench by the entrance and wake your companion to ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の列車は十一時十分発で到着が十二時、後の列車は十一時四十分発で到着が十二時半です。どちらも座席は約束できません。時刻をメモし、決まったら改めてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The next train leaves at 11:10 and arrives at noon; the later train leaves at 11:40 and arrives at 12:30. We cannot guarantee seats on either. Please note the times and consult us again once you've decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。本人には立つ可能性と到着時刻を両方伝え、座りたいかだけを聞いて選ばないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 立席可能性と到着時刻を両方説明して本人の希望を聞くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll explain both the possibility of standing and the arrival times, rather than choose by asking only whether they want a seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain both the possibility of standing and the arrival times and ask your companion's preference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内は変わる場合があるので、戻られた時にも表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Information may change, so please check the display again when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。まず本人の希望を聞き、戻ってから候補がまだ使えるか確かめます。今はどちらの列車とも決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望確認後に現在表示と照合し今は候補を決定しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll ask their preference first, then check whether those options are still available when I return. I won't choose either train yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that after checking their wishes you will compare the options with the current display, and will not decide now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの出発・到着時刻と、座れる保証はないことをお伝えできました。お連れ様の希望を聞き、戻った時に現在の案内と照合してからお選びください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've given you the two departure and arrival times and explained that seats aren't guaranteed. Please ask your companion's preference, compare with the current information when you return, and then choose. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。手続きでお困りの点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything troubling you about the application procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族の申込用写真を預かりました。顔だけで見分けると取り違えそうなので、裏に名前を書いてよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族写真の取り違え防止に裏面氏名記入可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've been given my family members' application photos. I might mix them up if I identify them by their faces alone, so I'd like to check whether I may write their names on the backs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether names may be written on the backs to prevent mixing up your family's photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真の提出条件を確認します。今は何枚お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the photo submission requirements. How many do you have with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三人分を一枚ずつです。同じ大きさなので、まだ袋から全部出して重ねないようにしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三人各一枚同サイズでまだ全て重ねず袋別に保持と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: One each for three people. They're the same size, so I've kept them in separate bags rather than take them all out and stack them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have one same-sized photo for each of three people and have kept them separately in their bags without stacking them all.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この申込みでは、裏面に名前を記入してください。本人との対応は確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: For this application, please write names on the backs. Have you checked which person each photo belongs to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋ごとに本人から受け取っています。どの袋が誰かを確かめ、一人分ずつ出して書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋と本人の対応を確認し一人ずつ出して記入すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I received each bag from the person concerned. I'll check whose bag is whose, take out one person's photo at a time, and write the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will verify the correspondence between each bag and person, then take out and label one person's photo at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表面を傷めないように記入してください。不確かな写真はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please write without damaging the front. Are there any photos you're unsure about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一枚だけ、袋に名前がありません。その一枚は顔の印象で決めず、本人に確認してから書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無名袋一枚は外観で判断せず本人確認して記入すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just one has no name on its bag. I won't decide whose it is from how the face looks; I'll check with the person before writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that one bag has no name and that you will verify with the person rather than judge by appearance before labeling it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる二枚だけ先に整えることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can prepare the two confirmed photos first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、二枚を記入して元の袋へ戻します。不明な一枚は未確認の袋へ分け、申込書に貼るのは確認後にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚を整えて戻し不明一枚は分け確認後申込書へ貼ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll label those two and return them to their original bags. I'll keep the unidentified one in a separate unconfirmed bag and attach it to the form only after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will prepare and return the two photos, keep the unknown one separate, and attach it to the form after confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二枚は袋と本人を照合して裏面へ記名し、名前のない一枚は本人へ確認してから準備する形ですね。未確認のまま貼らず、そろってからご提出ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: So you'll match the two bags to their owners and write names on the backs, and prepare the unnamed photo after checking with the person. Please don't attach it while unconfirmed; submit the photos once everything is ready. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 患者の付き添いですが、私は途中で帰る必要があります。「帰りたい」とだけ言うと患者も帰る希望だと思われそうなので、私のこととして相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅必要なのは付き添い自身で患者の帰宅希望ではないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm accompanying a patient, but I need to leave partway through. Saying only “I want to go home” might sound like the patient wants to leave too, so I'm asking about my own situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it is you, the accompanying person, who needs to go home, and that this is not a request for the patient to leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 患者さんご本人は、診察を待つ予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the patient intend to wait for the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。本人は診察を受けたいと言っています。私が帰る都合で、診察を取り消したいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 患者は診察希望で自都合による取消ではないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. They say they want to see the doctor. I don't want to cancel their consultation because I need to go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the patient wants the consultation and that your own circumstances do not mean you wish to cancel it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その後の連絡や付き添いについて、患者さんとは話しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you discussed subsequent contact or accompaniment with the patient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ十分に話せていません。先に本人へ帰る時間を伝え、その後に必要な支えを一緒に考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人へ時間を伝え残る間の支えを相談したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not sufficiently yet. I'd like to tell them when I need to leave first, then work out together what support they'll need afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to tell the patient your departure time and discuss support for the rest of their stay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付には、付き添いの変更としてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please speak to reception about changing the accompanying person.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族に来てもらえるか確認しますが、来ると決まっていない人を代わりの付き添いとして登録しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族来院を確認し未決定の人を代替登録しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll check whether a family member can come, but I won't register someone as a replacement companion before they've agreed to come.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check whether a family member can come and will not register an unconfirmed person as the replacement companion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 決まった内容をお知らせください。患者さんの希望も確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let us know what is decided. Please also check the patient's wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。本人の診察希望、私の帰宅時間、家族の対応可否を分けて確認してから戻って相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人希望自帰宅時間家族可否を確認して再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll separately check the patient's wish to see the doctor, my departure time, and whether the family can help, then return to consult you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the patient's wishes, your departure time, and the family's availability before consulting again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 診察を取り消す希望ではなく、付き添いの方が途中で帰るご相談と承りました。患者さんとご家族の意向を確かめ、決まった変更を受付へお知らせください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We understand that you are asking about the accompanying person leaving partway through, rather than canceling the consultation. Please check the patient's and family's wishes and inform reception of the agreed changes. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご相談の内容を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Please tell me what you would like to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 交差点で見た車を図にしましたが、この矢印は進行方向でなく、見た順番を表しています。図を見せる前に、その意味を説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図矢印は進行方向でなく目撃順と先に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I drew the cars I saw at the intersection, but this arrow shows the order I saw them, not their direction of travel. I'd like to explain that before showing the diagram.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese beforehand that the diagram's arrows indicate the order of observation, not the direction of travel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの車が向かった方向は別に覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you separately remember which direction each car went?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一台目は右へ曲がりました。二台目は途中で見えなくなったので、その先の方向は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一台右折確認二台目見失い先方向不明と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The first car turned right. I lost sight of the second one partway through, so I don't know which direction it went afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you saw the first car turn right but lost sight of the second and do not know its subsequent direction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二台目の行先を、一台目と同じ矢印で示さないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please don't use the same arrow as the first car's to show where the second went.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。順番の矢印は消さず、横に「見た順」と書きます。進行方向は分かる一台目だけ別に記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目撃順表記を付け進行は既知一台のみ別記すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll keep the arrow for the sequence and write “order seen” beside it. I'll separately mark the direction of travel only for the first car, whose direction I know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will label the sequence as the order seen and separately record only the known direction of the first car.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二台を同時に見ていたわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: So you weren't watching the two cars at the same time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうです。一台目を見送った後に二台目に気付きました。間の様子まで続けて見たとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一台見送り後二台目で間の連続目撃でないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: That's right. I noticed the second after watching the first go past. I can't say I watched continuously through the interval between them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you noticed the second car after the first had passed and did not continuously observe the interval.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 図の説明と、ご自身で見た範囲を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll hear your explanation of the diagram separately from what you actually witnessed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。車の順番、確認できた進行方向、見ていない間を分けます。図がきれいにつながるよう未確認の動きを足しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 順方向未視認間を分け図を完成させるため動きを補わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll distinguish the order of the cars, the confirmed directions, and the interval I didn't observe. I won't add unconfirmed movements just to make the diagram connect neatly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will distinguish sequence, direction, and the unobserved interval and will not fill in movements to complete the diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 目撃した順番と進行方向、見ていない間を分けて承りました。図の矢印にも説明を残します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've recorded separately the order you saw the cars, their directions, and the unobserved interval. We'll also retain the explanation beside the arrows. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。窓口へお越しになる前に何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help before you go to the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨傘と本の入った箱を持っていて、受付まで運びにくいです。箱を傘の水で濡らさないよう、台車を少しお借りできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濡れた雨傘と本の箱を受付へ運ぶため箱を濡らさず使える台車を借りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm carrying a wet umbrella and a box of books, and it's difficult to get them to reception. Could I borrow a trolley briefly so I don't get the box wet with water from the umbrella?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to borrow a trolley to carry a wet umbrella and a box of books to reception without wetting the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貸出しの台車が一台あります。箱はふたを閉じた状態でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have one trolley for lending. Is the box closed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、茶色い箱に本を入れてふたを閉じています。片手で箱を抱え直すより、台車に載せて持ち手を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本の箱のふたは閉じており片手で抱え直さず台車で運びたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The books are in a brown box with its lid closed. I'd rather put it on a trolley and use the handle than keep shifting it in one arm.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the book box is closed and that you would like to use a trolley rather than readjust it with one hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらへ載せられます。傘はまだ水が垂れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can put it here. Is water still dripping from the umbrella?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 垂れています。箱の上へ傘を直接置かず、傘袋を使ってから台車へ載せる場所を考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水の垂れる傘を箱へ直接置かず傘袋を使って載せ方を考えたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, it is. Rather than put the umbrella directly on the box, I'd like to put it in an umbrella bag first and then consider where to place it on the trolley.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the umbrella is dripping and that you want to bag it and consider its placement rather than put it directly on the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 傘袋は入口の右側です。台車には箱を中央へ置き、袋に入れた傘は箱に重ねず横へ置けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Umbrella bags are to the right of the entrance. Put the box in the middle of the trolley; the bagged umbrella can go beside it rather than on top.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。先に傘を袋へ入れ、箱と重ねずに載せます。窓口へ着くまで箱のふたも開けずに運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 傘を袋に入れ箱へ重ねず載せ箱は閉じたまま窓口へ運ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll bag the umbrella first and place it without stacking it on the box. I'll also keep the box closed until I reach the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will bag the umbrella, place it beside rather than on the box, and carry the closed box to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物を窓口へ渡した後、台車は入口横の返却場所へお戻しください。傘はお客様がお持ち帰りになりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After handing the box over at the counter, please return the trolley to the return area beside the entrance. You'll be taking your umbrella home, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。箱を窓口へ渡してから、自分の傘を取り、台車を返します。台車を返す時に傘を載せたままにしないよう確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱を窓口へ渡し自分の傘を取り忘れないよう取ってから台車を返すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll hand over the box, collect my umbrella, and return the trolley. I'll check that I haven't left my umbrella on it when I return it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will hand over the box, take your umbrella so you don't forget it, and then return the trolley.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 台車と傘袋の場所、返却の順序をご案内できました。箱を窓口へ運び、傘を取ってから台車をお戻しください。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've shown you where the trolley and umbrella bags are and explained the return order. Please take the box to the counter, collect your umbrella, and then return the trolley. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。取引の記録で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your transaction records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族から、生活費を入れた日と家賃が出た日を聞かれました。この一覧から二つの日付を探して、説明用にメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 生活費を入れた日と家賃が出た日を一覧から探し説明用に控えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family asked when I deposited the living expenses and when the rent went out. I'd like to find those two dates in this list and note them down to explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to find and note down the deposit date for living expenses and the rent payment date in the list for an explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様ご自身の記録ですね。生活費を入れた金額は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: These are your own records, correct? Do you remember how much you deposited for living expenses?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五万円です。ここに同じ金額が二つありますが、家族から受け取った分を入れたのは月の後半だったので、そちらを探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同額二件のうち月後半に家族分を入れた五万円の取引を探したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Fifty thousand yen. There are two transactions for that amount here, but I deposited the money I received from my family in the latter half of the month, so I'd like to find that one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that of the two 50,000-yen transactions you want to find the one in the latter half of the month for the money received from your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 後半の五万円は二十日の欄にあります。家賃の記載も見つかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The 50,000 yen in the latter half is in the entry for the twentieth. Can you also find the rent entry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの「家賃」という行です。二十三日と書いてあります。金額だけで探すより、日付と摘要も見ると見つけられました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家賃の摘要と二十三日を読み日付と摘要で見つけたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: This row marked “rent.” It says the twenty-third. Looking at both the date and description helped me find it, rather than searching only by amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you read the rent description and the twenty-third and found it by checking the date and description.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その二つをメモしていただけます。ほかの取引も、ご家族へ伝える必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can note those two down. Do you need to tell your family about other transactions too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今回はこの二つだけで大丈夫です。一覧全体の写真を送らず、五万円を入れた二十日と家賃の二十三日を文章で伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一覧写真全体を送らず二十日の入金と二十三日の家賃を文章で伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just these two are enough this time. Instead of sending a photo of the whole list, I'll tell them in writing about the 50,000-yen deposit on the twentieth and the rent on the twenty-third.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will send the deposit on the twentieth and rent on the twenty-third in writing rather than a photo of the entire list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: メモをご覧ください。お名前や口座番号まで写していませんね。元の一覧はお持ち帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at your note. You haven't copied your name or account number too, have you? Will you take the original list home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。日付と用件だけをメモに残し、元の一覧は持ち帰ります。家族にほかの質問があれば、その内容を聞いてから必要な箇所を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日付と用件だけを控え一覧を持ち帰り追加の質問に応じて確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll leave only the dates and purposes in my note and take the original list home. If my family has more questions, I'll hear what they are and then check the relevant parts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will note only the dates and purposes, take the list home, and check further details in response to additional questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの日付と用件を確認できました。メモと一覧のお忘れ物がないようにお持ち帰りください。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've checked the two dates and their purposes. Please take both your note and the list home without leaving anything behind. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が調味料のふたを開けにくいと言っています。同じ味でも、手でひねる力が少なくて済む容器があるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族がねじふたを開けにくく力が少なく済む調味料容器を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: A family member says the condiment lid is hard to open. I'd like to ask whether there's a container for the same flavor that takes less hand strength to twist open.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about a condiment container that needs less force because your family member finds screw-top lids difficult to open.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今はどのようなふたを使っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: What kind of lid are they using now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 固いねじ式です。味を変えてほしいのではなく、毎回私が開けなくても使える容器を一緒に探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 味変更でなく自身介助なしに使える容器を探したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: A stiff screw top. I'm not asking to change the flavor; I'd like to find a container together that they can use without my opening it every time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are looking for a container they can use without your help, rather than a change of flavor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 押して開く形もあります。売場の商品は開けずに、見本で確かめられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are push-to-open types too. You can check a sample without opening the products on the shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見本を試したいです。押す方式なら必ず使いやすいと決めず、開く時と閉じる時の両方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封商品でなく見本で開閉両方を確かめたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to try the sample. I won't assume a push type is necessarily easier to use; I'll check both opening and closing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check both opening and closing using the sample rather than unopened merchandise.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの見本でお試しください。中身を出す量も形によって変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please try this sample. The amount dispensed also differs with the shape.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開けるのは軽いですが、一度に多く出そうですね。家族が使う時に少量ずつ出せるかも見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開く軽さ以外に少量ずつ注げるかを確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's easy to open, but it looks like a lot might come out at once. I'd also like to check whether my family member could dispense small amounts at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that besides ease of opening you want to check whether small amounts can be poured at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の使いやすさは、こちらだけでは判断できません。形の情報を持ち帰れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can't judge here alone whether it will be easy for the person themselves to use. You can take information about the shape home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、容器の形と操作を家族へ伝えて相談します。私が開けられたから本人も使えると決めず、今日は購入を保留します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人へ操作情報を共有し自分の成功で本人使用可と決めず保留すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll tell my family member about the container's shape and operation and discuss it. I won't assume they can use it just because I could open it, and I'll hold off buying it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will share how it works with the person and postpone buying rather than infer they can use it from your own success.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご検討のうえ、またお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please consider it and let us know if you need anything else.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is anything troubling you in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紙飛行機を飛ばしていましたが、風で通路の方まで流れました。続けて飛ばすのをやめて、まず拾い集めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 風で紙飛行機が通路へ流れ遊び中断し回収したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was flying paper airplanes, but the wind carried them toward the path. I'd like to stop flying them and collect them first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the wind carried your paper airplanes toward the path, so you want to stop playing and collect them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 飛んでいった場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know where they went?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見える二機は通路脇です。もう一機は植え込みの方へ飛びましたが、どこに落ちたかまでは見えませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二機通路脇で一機植込方向だが着地点は未視認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two that I can see are beside the path. Another flew toward the bushes, but I couldn't see exactly where it landed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that two are beside the path and one flew toward the bushes, but you did not see its landing spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通行する人に気を付けてください。植え込みへは入らないでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please watch out for people passing by. Don't go into the bushes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見える二機から拾います。植え込みの一機は勝手に踏み込まず、落ちたかもしれない場所をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見える分を拾い植込へ入らず未確認場所を伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll pick up the two I can see first. I won't enter the bushes without permission for the other one; I'll tell you where it may have landed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will collect the visible ones and report the uncertain location without entering the bushes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで確認します。風が弱くなるまで待って続ける予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check there. Were you planning to wait until the wind eases and continue?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は片付けます。風が一瞬止まったからといって、また同じ場所で飛ばすのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 瞬間風が止んでも再開せず今日は片付けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll pack up for today. I won't fly them again in the same place just because the wind stops for a moment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will pack up today and not resume even if the wind briefly stops.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。回収できた数を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please check how many you've collected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三機持って来たので、二機回収、一機未確認です。拾った数だけで全部片付いたと思わず、残る一機の情報を残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持参三機回収二機未確認一機と数え残る情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I brought three, so two have been collected and one is unconfirmed. I won't assume everything is cleared away just from the number I've picked up; I'll leave information about the remaining one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you brought three, collected two, and have one unconfirmed, and provide information about the remaining one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三機のうち二機を回収し、植え込み側の一機は未確認と承りました。今日は飛ばすのを終え、残る一機は係が確認します。片付けについてお知らせいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We understand that two of the three have been collected and one toward the bushes is unconfirmed. Please finish flying them today; a staff member will check for the remaining one. Thank you for letting us know about the cleanup.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が書いた駅名を読めません。似ている音の駅を選ぶ前に、この文字から行き先を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読めない手書き駅名を似た音へ置換せず確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't read the station name my friend wrote. Before choosing a station with a similar-sounding name, I'd like to confirm the destination from these characters.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to verify an unreadable handwritten station name rather than replace it with a similar-sounding one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書いたものを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me what they wrote?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。最後の一文字は読めますが、最初の二文字に自信がありません。全部読めたふりをして伝えたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 末字のみ読め冒頭二字不確かと紙を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I can read the last character, but I'm unsure of the first two. I don't want to tell you while pretending I can read the whole thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the paper and explain in Japanese that you can read only the final character and are uncertain about the first two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: これだけでは判別できない部分があります。友人へ確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Some parts can't be identified from this alone. Can you check with your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話できます。こちらで駅を当ててもらうより、友人に文字を大きく書き直して送ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人へ連絡でき大きな文字で再送を頼むと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can call them. Rather than ask you to guess the station, I'll ask my friend to rewrite it in larger characters and send it to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you can contact your friend and will ask them to resend it in larger characters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読み仮名も付けてもらうと確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If they add the pronunciation, we can check that too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうします。音だけでは別の駅と混ざるかもしれないので、漢字と読み方の両方を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別駅混同を避け漢字と読み両方を依頼すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll do that. Sound alone might get mixed up with another station, so I'll ask for both the kanji and the reading.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will request both the kanji and the reading to avoid confusing it with another station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できたら、路線も一緒に調べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once it's confirmed, let's check the line as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今の不鮮明な紙だけで切符を買わず、友人の返事と駅名、路線を確認してから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鮮明な返事と駅路線確認後に切符相談をすると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't buy a ticket from this unclear paper alone; I'll consult you after checking my friend's reply, the station name, and the line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will consult about a ticket after receiving a clear reply and checking the station and line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今の文字だけでは駅名を確定できないことを確認しました。ご友人から漢字と読み方が届いてから、路線の相談を承ります。切符はその確認後にお求めください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've established that we can't determine the station name from the current writing alone. Once your friend sends the kanji and reading, we'll help you with the line. Please buy your ticket after that confirmation. Thank you for consulting us.
